0022600187.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-5, on a four-game losing streak and 12th in the West) host the Orlando Magic (2-5, on a two-game losing streak and 12th in the East) in the Suns' seventh game of the season, with Phoenix 1-2 at home and Orlando 0-4 at home. Phoenix is missing Jordan Goodwin (calf), Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain), while Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not met yet this season, and the last meeting was a 115-111 Orlando win in Orlando on March 31, 2026.
